description: This file defines the PartitionInterface in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a section of the AWS cloud with methods for obtaining partition information and endpoints.

classes.name: PartitionInterface
classes.description: An interface representing a section of the AWS cloud that provides methods for retrieving partition name, matching regions, getting available endpoints, and invoking the partition as an endpoint provider.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the partition's short name, e.g., 'aws', 'aws-cn', or 'aws-us-gov'.

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Determines if the partition contains the provided region, including non-regional endpoints for specific services.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the endpoints supported by a given service, with an option to include non-regional endpoints.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the partition to be invoked as an endpoint provider, returning endpoint information.
